findings.now: The year stays a free-text box after the return is created from the tile, and a retyped year saves as a separate new draft, leaving any saved draft for the original year unchanged.
findings.why: Drafts are keyed by TIN, form and year (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:154), so an edited year inserts a second row instead of updating the return the filer opened.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the tile's year as a locked chip, so a different year means opening that year's own tile.

options.name: Year combobox on new drafts
options.detail: Offer 2018 to the current year in a combobox only before the draft is saved, then lock it.

findings.now: Errors show as red labels and as one list below Schedule 2 that stops at 20 messages, so later alerts never appear and Queue stays disabled with no message beside the field.
findings.why: The brief requires every official alert to appear verbatim and in order, and the 20-message cap drops alerts silently once blank schedule rows produce more than 20 messages.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Render each alert under its own field, verbatim and in the official order.

options.name: Uncapped summary
options.detail: Show the complete alert list above the schedules with a jump link to each field.
